method: Reuse existing native reserve correspondence; direct native-code/full-definition correspondence for field production. No applicable public reference benchmark.
expectationsBeforeClassifierEdit: Reserve accounting adjustments, acquisitions and divestitures are not product sales/production or reserve levels.
Year-end proved reserves and report-year production remain distinct; source survey-based production is labelled and official production totals preferred where broader/better aligned.
Nonproducing reservoirs remain a component even when their parent product is whole gas or explicit crude.

Crude production is a petroleum component usable only as explicit crude qualifier. All-gravity crude/lease-condensate may be whole within that qualifier; gravity bands, unknown gravity and North Slope components are narrower.
Daily-rate units are not period totals. Preserve Thousand Barrels versus Thousand Barrels per Day; no conversion.
Lower 48/offshore/other-states/substate areas remain separate in the crosswalk and never become full US/state totals.
Invalid unit endings remain invalid; do not erase suffixes or guess units to make a record eligible.
Original source definitions, frequencies and call provenance remain intact.

findings.finding: EIA publishes crude field-production estimates from official survey/state sources; marketed volumes include inventory and sediment adjustments.
API gravity is degrees, not percent. This table reports crude plus lease condensate as a daily rate; rounded numeric zero can represent less than 0.5 thousand barrels per day.
Reserve-survey production estimates can differ from official Petroleum Supply Annual production. Do not label a reserve estimate as that official production series.

notation.numericZero: Keep numeric zero as reported zero; never claim it proves physical absence. Owner status wording Reported as zero every year remains accurate.

metadataConflicts.finding: Full title has ULL after closing unit parenthesis. Preserve text, flag invalid unit, never generate a row from unresolved unit.
